notes: Skill names are regenerated from the game client - the bundled list dated from early July and no longer matched the game; two pairs had swapped outright (Cleric's Judgment Thunder / Divine Punishment and the Spiritmaster's Wind Spirit: Storm / Earth Spirit: Colossal Stalk), so the breakdown labelled damage with the wrong skill. 1,062 names corrected, 7,357 skills added. Fixes: a player with a very small entity id (under 100) was skipped by the damage and buff parsers, so a full party could show one row short; a boss reporting below-zero remaining HP overflowed a 32-bit conversion and crashed the packet assembler, leaving the kill undetected and the fight never uploaded; a boss from the previous zone could stay selected as the current target; an invisible skill-effect actor with a real-looking nickname was counted as an extra party member; a name found far from its entity id in a spawn packet is now accepted only when a valid class code follows it; boss recognition is now generated from the game client's own data - new bosses on Bakron Island (Tiere, Thamon, Vakron) are recognised, Draupnir's first boss Afflicted Bakarma is detected in every difficulty instead of only the second boss, 2,600 NPCs were added and stale entries that made ordinary monsters read as bosses were removed; the debug log no longer erases itself completely when it reaches its size cap.
